initialization: Each new study starts from the released base, not the previous paper RFT checkpoint

training.selection: Fastest measured safe candidate; full-data semantics unchanged

inputs.short_sequences: Keep actual images; no duplication or invented FPS
inputs.frame_selection: Locked media manifest, no runtime subsampling
inputs.geofits_grid: Same letterbox field of view resized to392 for patch14 teachers; Qwen448/patch16

tip.loss: MSE reconstruction plus wrong-support hinge plus unmasked MSE

georoute.baseline_policy: Matched RGB SFT removed by user; historical RGB results are not a data-matched causal baseline

strength_protocol.selection: Validation only; shared protocol across five arms; never select on visual contrast or test score

geofits.timestamp_rule: Measured normalized sincos when available; otherwise explicitly order_only_sincos

evaluation.protocol: Same image inputs and adapted output format for all local models, separate from published leaderboard values
evaluation.scoring: Pinned benchmark-specific official arithmetic, gold-blind extraction, per-task denominators
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final checkpoint; never choose on test
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap grouped by independent source scene/video where available; single seed limitation explicit

supplement_status: Underspecified values are declared local choices, not claimed official hyperparameters
